steps.title: Open the Dashboard
steps.narration: We're visiting the homepage to see the daily snapshot at a glance, verifying the frontend loads cleanly in production mode.
steps.point_out: The Dashboard heading, subtitle, and regime/phase panels load without errors or the Next.js dev-overlay pill.

steps.title: Navigate to the Stocks leaderboard
steps.narration: Click Stocks in the sidebar to browse the ranked stock leaderboard—still clean and responsive in production mode.
steps.point_out: The Stocks heading appears and the leaderboard table populates with ranked rows.

steps.title: Search for AAPL and click its row
steps.narration: Type 'AAPL' into the search field and click the matching row to drill into the stock's detail page, confirming cross-page navigation works.
steps.point_out: The leaderboard filters to show AAPL, then clicking it navigates to the stock detail page.

steps.title: View the AAPL stock detail with three explainable scores
steps.narration: The stock detail page shows Leadership, Entry Quality, and Risk scores—three explainable figures, never blank or undefined.
steps.point_out: Three score cards render with numeric scores or honest NA states; no dev-overlay pill appears anywhere on the page.

steps.title: Navigate to Data Manager and verify the run history
steps.narration: The Data Manager shows coverage stats and ingest job history—the page loads without spinners or blank panels, confirming that data-loading endpoints work under production mode.
steps.point_out: The Data Manager heading, coverage tiles, and run history panel all render with real data.

steps.title: Open Research and click the Regime Lab card
steps.narration: The Research page hosts the Regime Lab—a two-click path from the Dashboard, unchanged by the launcher fix, demonstrating stable navigation.
steps.point_out: The Research page shows available lab cards, and clicking Regime Lab navigates to that research tool.

steps.title: View the Backtest page with past scan evidence
steps.narration: The Backtest page lets you rewind to a past scan date and see forward-test evidence—a complete, data-rich page that loads cleanly, confirming the platform's core analytical pages work in production mode.
steps.point_out: The Backtest heading and 'As-of scan summary' section render fully with honest NA or real figures; no loading skeleton lingers.

steps.title: Browse the Watchlist—your saved stocks
steps.narration: The Watchlist page displays your saved stocks with concentration analysis—the page loads without errors, showing that production mode handles multiple data sources gracefully.
steps.point_out: The Watchlist heading and saved stock rows render; if saved tickers exist, the concentration X-ray panels appear.
